sourceArticle.title: OpenCode | The open source AI coding agent
sourceArticle.author: Unknown

athenaOutput.directive: The Creative Liberation Engine will continue to architect and build its own sovereign, self-hosted AI coding agent, drawing inspiration from leading solutions like OpenCode while adhering strictly to Article I: Sovereignty.
athenaOutput.rationale: The Creative Liberation Engine's constitutional mandate (Article I: Sovereignty) and prior strategic decisions prioritize the development of entirely self-hosted, owned AI solutions. While OpenCode presents valuable features and an open-source model, its reliance on external LLM providers and existing AI subscriptions (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Plus) makes it fundamentally misaligned with the Creative Liberation Engine's core principle of self-ownership and sovereignty. The features demonstrated by OpenCode serve as excellent benchmarks and inspiration for capabilities to be engineered directly into the Creative Liberation Engine's own AI coding agent, a direction already established in previous ATHENA strategies. Therefore, a direct implementation or adoption of 'OpenCode' is redundant, as the Creative Liberation Engine is already on a path to embody and surpass such capabilities in a sovereign manner.
